summary: Venture Global, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Venture Global LNG, Inc., entered into a 364-day senior secured revolving credit facility with Bank of America as administrative agent, allowing borrowings up to $3 billion, maturing September 1, 2027. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The facility is secured by substantially all existing and future assets of VGLNG. This is a routine credit agreement, not a special situation. No deal terms. Watch for future covenant compliance or drawdowns, but no strategic event.
